source_name: NBS – makro komentáre on hromadné prepúšťania and unemployment
why_relevant: Central bank analytical commentaries interpret the labour-office redundancy notification series, giving dated, quantified context and occasionally sector breakdowns that the raw ÚPSVaR releases omit.

source_name: NBS – Upozornenie: predchádzajúci súhlas na kvalifikovanú účasť
why_relevant: Notices/instructions section of NBS. Qualifying-holding consents precede ownership changes, which are the most reliable leading indicator of subsequent board turnover at Slovak banks and payment institutions.

source_name: NBS – individual sanction decision PDFs (ofsrozhodnutia)
why_relevant: Full-text sanction decisions published as PDFs under a predictable path. Full texts, unlike the summary table, can name responsible officers and describe governance failures.

source_name: NBS – legislation detail: Opatrenie 1/2025 amending Opatrenie 6/2010 on §28 prior-consent applications
why_relevant: Documents exactly which fit-and-proper facts a bank must file with NBS when appointing board members and key function holders — i.e. defines the structure and richness of the underlying record set the A5 workstream mines.

source_name: NBS – historical PDF compendia of decision operative parts (útvar dohľadu nad finančným trhom)
why_relevant: Pre-portal era PDFs collecting the operative parts of NBS decisions by year. Search snippets showed these explicitly contain prior-consent decisions naming individuals elected as board members / appointed as senior employees at named Slovak banks — a proven template for what the modern register contains and a source of long-run history.

source_name: ÚPSVaR – Hromadné prepúšťanie (employer duties + notification procedure)
why_relevant: Central Office of Labour, Social Affairs and Family is the statutory recipient of collective-redundancy notifications (§73 Zákonník práce). Defines what an employer legally must disclose, when, and to whom — the anchor for any SK bank/payment-firm headcount-cut signal.

source_name: MHSR – Koncepcia podpory centier podnikových služieb na Slovensku (policy paper)
why_relevant: Government strategy document on the business-services sector: baseline headcount, regional distribution, skills pipeline and policy levers. Useful for structural context and for the official Slovak terminology used in later announcements.

source_name: Bankart d.o.o. executive profiles (regional card-processing hub)
why_relevant: Bankart is a regional card/payment processor serving CEE banks; its management-board announcements are made on personal profiles first. Demonstrates the cell's core hypothesis (person announces before employer) and covers processor-side org change affecting SK issuers.

source_name: SITA / V Financiách – union-vs-banks bargaining coverage
why_relevant: National wire service with a dedicated finance vertical; carries union statements, mediator requests and SBA rebuttals with dates — the practical trigger feed for the union/legal channel when union sites lag.

source_name: Erste Group Annual Report — Strategy & segment reporting (online edition)
why_relevant: Annual report segment chapters give the auditable Slovakia baseline: employees, branches, segment result and organisational structure. This is the denominator against which any announced headcount programme should be measured.

source_name: Startitup.sk — banking leadership-change reporting
why_relevant: Demonstrated concrete SK-language coverage of bank board changes (UniCredit CZ/SK new CEO; Privatbanka board strengthening), naming individuals whose LinkedIn profiles then become watchlist entries.

source_name: ECB SSM Supervisory Manual (fit-and-proper / common procedures)
why_relevant: Explains how SSM fit-and-proper assessments are initiated by the NCA (NBS) and decided by the ECB, including timelines. Essential for interpreting the lag between an NBS filing and a public appointment, and for knowing which artefacts are ever public.

source_name: ITAS — leadership election announcements (prezident/viceprezidenti/predstavenstvo)
why_relevant: Board-election posts name individuals together with their employer (Cisco, Microsoft, Asseco, Slovak Telekom, Posam, Samsung, Asbis…), i.e. a dated snapshot of ICT senior management. Repeated every term, so diffs are leadership-move signals.

source_name: Forbes Slovensko — LinkedIn / labour-market and executive coverage
why_relevant: Forbes SK covers both executive changes (e.g. Profesia CEO succession) and LinkedIn-derived labour-market data for Slovakia, giving a bridge between the person-centric channel and quantified hiring trends.

source_name: PwC Slovakia – Shared Service Centres practice and SARIO/PwC SSC sector reports
why_relevant: Advisory firm that co-authors the SARIO SSC sector study; provides headcount, function-mix (finance, risk, IT) and city-level splits for business service centres, including financial-services captives.

source_name: STVR spravodajstvo – public broadcaster coverage of bank labour disputes and redundancies
why_relevant: Public broadcaster reports both union claims and employer/association responses, and separately covers regional mass-redundancy notifications — a corroboration layer for events first visible in labour-office data.

source_name: Štátna pokladnica – Osobitné podmienky pre poskytovanie služieb platobnej brány ŠP
why_relevant: The Treasury operates its own payment gateway for public-sector clients and publishes its terms and pricing. These documents identify the technical/processing arrangement behind SK public-sector e-payments and the ŠP unit that owns it — directly relevant to who the function owners are and which vendors sit underneath.

source_name: AKMV advokátska kancelária — premeny obchodných spoločností / poplatky ORSR
why_relevant: Practitioner commentary that decodes register mechanics: what Act 309/2023 changed for mergers from 1.3.2024, what annexes accompany a statutory-body change, registry-court deadlines (two business days domestic, 21 days cross-border). Valuable as an interpretation layer so register timestamps are read correctly; not evidence of any specific company event.

entity_name: Crunchbase / PitchBook / Dealroom company profiles for SK fintech actors
source_name: Crunchbase / PitchBook / Dealroom company profiles for SK fintech actors
why_relevant: Funding-round and headcount metadata for named cell actors (Vacuumlabs ~340 staff and ~$4.5M raised per the profiles found; Fumbi carries a PitchBook profile). Headcount trend plus round dates give the quantitative backbone against which qualitative hiring signals are scored. Dealroom aggregates cited ~200 tracked SK startups and ~$336M VC invested.

source_name: EU-OSHA OSHwiki – Worker participation in Slovakia
why_relevant: English-language structural overview of SK employee representation (odborová organizácia, zamestnanecká rada, zamestnanecký dôverník) and consultation duties — useful bridge document for mapping the workforce-side actors before local-language collection.

source_name: EU-Startups – Slovakia ecosystem coverage
why_relevant: English-language ecosystem roundups that name promising SK startups and cite Dealroom aggregates. Useful as an outside-in cross-check on the local actor map and for catching SK-founded firms that communicate mainly in English.

source_name: Finweek Bratislava 2026 — Eventbrite listing
why_relevant: Mirror of the conference agenda with dates and session descriptions; useful as a fallback when the organiser site changes structure, and Eventbrite search is itself a pointer to smaller SK fintech meetups.

source_name: J&T Global Finance (bond issuance vehicles) — annual reports
why_relevant: Financing SPVs whose English annual reports disclose group structure changes and guarantor composition; an indirect but legally compelled window on J&T's Slovak perimeter after the 365.bank sale.

source_name: org-id.guide — SK-ORSR identifier list
why_relevant: Canonical description of the SK-ORSR organisation-identifier scheme (IČO), its coverage and access conditions. Needed to make IČO the join key across ORSR, RPO, RÚZ, RPVS, Obchodný vestník and any commercial aggregator — the prerequisite for a coherent org-change dataset.

source_name: Spaceplan – office market and shared-services centre commentary (SK)
why_relevant: Office-market intelligence linking SSC growth to leased square metres by city — an indirect but early physical-footprint signal of centre expansion or contraction in regional cities.

source_name: The Banker — Bank of the Year Awards (Slovakia) and bank press releases about it
why_relevant: Tatra banka was named Slovak Bank of the Year 2025 by The Banker. Award write-ups and the winning bank's own press release quote the executives who own the initiative, with exact titles — a low-noise way to attach names to strategic functions (digital, private banking).
